notes: Formal written Persian as in published Bibles. A chapter heading is «باب {n}» (the word Persian Bibles use for a chapter). Licensing statements are rendered literally: «تکثیر» for copy, «تغییر دادن» for modify, «مالکیت عمومی» for public domain. Persian punctuation (، ؛ ؟) and the zero-width non-joiner where standard (می‌توان، یادداشت‌ها); «ـهٔ» for the ezafe after a silent h (همهٔ).
